summary: V26.d Master Voice Recorder backend fixes verified. Created new test file /app/backend/tests/test_v26d_recorder_fixes.py with 5 tests covering: multi-target save (personal+contact+group → 3 independent records), rename success flow (POST → PUT title → GET returns updated title), rename auth required (401), rename 404 when audio_id doesn't exist, and 'I miei audio' personal listing scoped correctly (excludes contact/group records). All 5 new tests PASS. Existing 9 tests in test_v26b_audio_records.py also PASS (no regressions). Total: 14/14 passed. Frontend not tested (MediaRecorder requires real microphone).
action_items: Frontend testing skipped: MediaRecorder audio flow requires real microphone; main agent should smoke-test /master screen manually (multi-destination checkboxes save button count, backdrop tap no longer discards audio, /my-audios page reachable from FAB button + 3-dot menu, rename inline flow).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/audio-records/{id}/title correctly checks tenant scope + creator authorization (owner OR created_by == user), trims/limits to 200 chars, and returns {ok, title}. Sets title to None when empty string passed — good.
GET /api/audio-records?target_type=personal correctly restricts to created_by == current user (server.py:3827-3828), so 'I miei audio' will not leak other team members' personal recordings.

Multi-target save is implemented client-side as N parallel POSTs (no backend batch endpoint). Server correctly creates independent audio_id per POST — verified in test_multi_target_save_creates_independent_records.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: personal/contact/group audio_records + one V26d Test Group created and cleaned up in fixtures/finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rename endpoint is PUT /api/audio-records/{audio_id}/title with body {title:string}. Returns {ok:true, title:string|null}. 401 without auth, 404 for missing audio, 403 for non-creator non-owner (not covered by test but present in code at server.py:3849). Personal listing at GET /api/audio-records?target_type=personal is scoped to created_by == current_user.
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification pass only. All three original bugs have working backend support: (1) multi-target = client issues N POSTs, verified independent; (2) rename now backed by PUT title endpoint; (3) my-audios uses existing GET /api/audio-records?target_type=personal already scoped to created_by.
